title: Minimum Remove to Make Valid Parentheses
summary: Given a string s containing only '(' and ')' along with lowercase English letters, remove the least number of parentheses to make the string valid.
statement: Given a string s containing only '(' and ')' along with lowercase English letters, remove the least number of parentheses to make the string valid. A valid string meets the criteria of being empty, consisting only of lowercase letters, or being a concatenation of valid substrings or a single valid substring.
constraints: Remove the fewest parentheses to make the string valid.
Letters remain in their original order.
hints: Track indices of unmatched opening parentheses.
Match each close to the latest open; mark unmatched closes immediately.
After scanning, remove opens left on the stack and every marked close.
Every removed parenthesis is unmatched, and retaining all matched pairs minimizes removals.
editorial: Every removed parenthesis is unmatched, and retaining all matched pairs minimizes removals.

tests.explanation: Removing the unmatched final close parenthesis yields lee(t(c)o)de.
Removing the early unmatched close yields ab(c)d.
